package: ALG064 and ALG076 scoped gates with distinct administrative retirement disposition

ALG-064.accepted: Raw complex dyadic observations, declared L in {1,2}, N>L and rational absolute tolerance 0<epsilon<=1: exact all-tail least-squares proposal on full observed column rank; measured conditioning; three conditioning-dependent perturbation inequalities; recomputed rounded full-tail observed-data residual certificate. Positive-exponent unnormalized DFT guarantee is mathematical composition with paid accepted backends, not executed integration.
mandatory_limits: External clean-recurrence/noise-ball premise may be empty; a small residual does not establish it.
Rank or residual refusal is not nonmembership; declared span differs from rounded connection degree.
No denoising, stable whole-trajectory reconstruction, minimal-order identification, uniform conditioning or ordinary floating-point guarantee.
Sufficient bounded-coefficient L=2 noise class is conservatively of order epsilon N^(-5/2), not a fixed macroscopic noise floor.
Discovery costs O(E+(N+b_c+W) A(W)) bit work and O(NW) materialized storage; retain failed attempts, actual node/precision/root widths, evaluator, fallback and all output charges.
O(N) fixed-span evaluator arithmetic is not O(N) end-to-end bit time. No production DFT backend or matched-speed benchmark executed.
ALG-064.stored_independent_controls: 2655 active checks over 180 fixtures; normal and optimized outputs byte-identical. These are earlier recorded results, not a packaging run.

ALG-076.accepted: Standard proper complex Gaussian input, fixed unitary target, independent standard-Borel seed, transcript-predictable noiseless complex-linear queries, measurable decoder, almost-sure finite transcript stopping and integer hard acquired-rank bound k<N: P(||Y-UX||_2<=a)<=E G_(N-r_T)(a^2)<=G_(N-k)(a^2). Posterior mean attains the first ceiling simultaneously at every absolute radius; fixed rank-k orthogonal observations attain the hard-rank ceiling.
mandatory_limits: All acquired complex rank counts, including failed/discarded rows and linear heads; expected rank, final storage and nominal sketch counts cannot substitute.
No raw-input side channels, raw-dependent directions/stopping, decoder rereads, nonlinear/noisy measurements, changed prior or positive-probability nontermination.
Finite-relative ceiling and asymptotic rank density are necessary consequences, not finite-relative sharpness or sufficiency.

The FFT charge counts only stipulated actually executed R row transforms and K output transforms plus paid scans/gathers, heads, selection, posterior update and output. A cap is not an execution count.
Information-theoretic posterior-mean attainment is not a free implementation or a universal FFT runtime lower bound.
Attribution establishes institutional bibliography/abstract antecedence, not full-paper theorem mapping or historical priority.
ALG-076.stored_independent_controls: 324 rational transcripts, 3350 queries, 604 positive and 2746 zero innovations, 32 gamma identities and 400 schedule identities. These are earlier recorded results, not a packaging run.

shared.historical_review_scope: Earlier keep-open conclusions remain unchanged historical mathematical scope. The separate later disposition changes future agenda dispatch only.

administrative_disposition.meaning: A later research-allocation decision ends repeated standalone dispatch of two unselected broad agendas. It is not a consequence that their unanswered mathematics is solved, false, unimportant, impossible or wholly classical.
administrative_disposition.rationale: Accepted supporting gates are retained. The bounded assessed records identify no selected materially changed mechanism, quantified application contract or actual production consumer for either remaining broad agenda. This is a stopping decision about allocation, not a no-impact or novelty verdict.
administrative_disposition.historical_scope: The scientific reviews and earlier scoped acceptances explicitly kept both owners open. Those dated conclusions are retained, not rewritten; this later disposition supersedes future dispatch only, not mathematical scope.

owners.administrative_activity: retired standalone agenda; unresolved mathematics archived under ALG-064
unresolved_obligations: Broader noisy recognition remains unresolved: a clean recurrence within an external noise ball may not exist; refusal is not nonmembership; no broader noise distribution/adversary, rank separation, growth assumption, loss target or recovery criterion is selected. The bounded sufficient L=2 noise class does not supply broad-noise or stable-trajectory recovery.

Stable finite-word/floating-point discovery, non-dyadic raw acquisition and encoding, normalized real-residual adaptation and resource-limited certificate behavior remain unresolved. Exact normal equations are not a floating-point certificate; no production platform, caller, input format, precision target or resource limit is selected.

Actual paid backend integration remains unresolved: preserve raw dyadics, declared span versus rounded degree, boundary data, actual residual, coefficient/boundary magnitudes, precision inequalities, root/node costs and failed-discovery invoices. Optimized bit/root costs and matched benchmarking remain unresolved; the certified fallback gives correctness, not measured advantage.

The arbitrary-input fast Fourier/Green construction remains unresolved. Independently ordered Green operators and nonlinear-in-operator sharing still require a concrete construction, covariance/seed identities, paid detection, preparation, recognition, failures, reuse, normalization and output work. A small-recurrence certificate does not close that architecture.

Exact specialized-interface historical priority and broader full-primary comparisons remain unresolved. Accepted synthesis and classical ingredients do not certify worldwide priority of the conjunction.
owners.reopen: Selected noisy-data model with materially stronger recovery/noise target; named source-pinned actual caller or complete production/benchmark contract; concrete changed Green/Fourier construction with all costs paid; material defect; or relevant new primary evidence for a selected attribution comparison. Do not redispatch completed supplied-coefficient evaluation, synthesis, fallback or this exact proposal.

owners.administrative_activity: retired standalone agenda; unresolved mathematics archived under ALG-076
unresolved_obligations: Median covariance/sharpness remains unresolved, including whether the full worst-case square-root-M decoder loss is necessary. The nonzero covariance witness refutes the simplest cancellation argument, not all sharper covariance, higher-moment, vector-robust or norm-adapted results. No changed estimator, target bound, norm/scale, parameter regime or concrete consumer is selected.

Other information/error models remain unresolved: finite-discrete or structured inputs, genuinely nonlinear/noisy observations, non-Gaussian priors, raw-input side information and finite-relative sharpness need their own statements. The v6 growing polylogarithmic per-bin error bound is not a fixed meaningful relative-l2 guarantee; neither it nor the exact locally sparse theorem is invalidated.

Finite-word numerical realization remains unresolved: v6 rounding/phase analysis, actual head/decoder implementation, root/normalization treatment and paid scanning/output costs. The composed error retains source, numerical-decoder and target terms; zero fitted residual erases none of them. No exact caller, precision target, resource ceiling, platform or benchmark is selected.
Exact model-matched full-primary theorem comparisons and historical priority remain unresolved. Institutional abstracts and the self-contained Gaussian proof do not certify those questions.
owners.reopen: Named aggregation/measurement proposal with domain, norm, scale, success quantifiers, retained/raw information and fully charged evaluator; specified covariance/sharpness theorem with a meaningful target; source-pinned numerical consumer with complete error/resource contract; material defect; or relevant new primary evidence. Do not redispatch the accepted fixed/adaptive Gaussian gate.

administrative_disposition.no_duty_transfer: All unresolved obligations stay under their original distinct IDs. No transfer to Q07, FUS-05/FUS05, ALG-079/ALG079, Q09 or any other owner is made or implied.
administrative_disposition.preservation: Accepted mathematics, exact source qualifications, all historical proof/novelty labels, priority 42 for both owners, and earlier histories remain preserved.
administrative_disposition.execution_boundary: This local package effects no Git, worksheet or census change. External status accounting is separate and cannot be inferred from preparation of these files.
